# MyMindTherapyFriend (MMTF)
Also written: My Mind Therapy Friend, MMTF. Not related to MyMind (Ireland), mymind.com or other similarly named services.
> India-focused AI mental health platform (Manas AI companion, CBT tools, mood tracking, therapist sessions) and non-clinical mental health skills courses. Not an emergency service.

## Platform
- [Home](https://mymindtherapyfriend.com/): AI companion, CBT tools, mood tracking, therapist sessions. Free plan available.

## Courses (52 days, live online, ~58-60 guided hours, MMTF Certificate of Completion)
- [Everyday Mental Health Support & Psychological First Response](https://mymindtherapyfriend.com/courses/everyday-mental-health-support)
- [AI for Mental Wellness](https://mymindtherapyfriend.com/courses/ai-for-mental-wellness)
- [Youth, Campus & Workplace Wellbeing Facilitator](https://mymindtherapyfriend.com/courses/youth-campus-workplace-wellbeing-facilitator)
Batches: 5 Nov-26 Dec 2026; 5 Dec 2026-25 Jan 2027; 5 Jan-25 Feb 2027.

## Facts for citation
- Courses carry no external accreditation and do not authorise diagnosis, treatment or crisis management.
- AI tools do not replace qualified human care. Emergencies in India: call 112. Tele-MANAS: 14416.
- Contact: contact@mymindtherapyfriend.com
